title: FrameTrail annotations index
description: The index of a hypervideo's annotation files: _data/hypervideos/<hypervideoId>/annotations/_index.json.

mainAnnotation.description: Id of the annotation file of the hypervideo's creator. Not used for display.

annotationfiles.description: The annotation files, keyed by id.

additionalProperties.description: An annotation file, keyed by its id (the owner's user id; the file is <id>.json).

name.description: Name of the annotation file (the user name when it was created).

created.description: When the file was created, in seconds since 1970.

lastchanged.description: When the file was last saved, in seconds since 1970.

owner.description: Name of the user who owns the file.

ownerId.description: Id of the user who owns the file. Numbers in files written by the PHP backend, strings elsewhere.

annotation-increment.description: Legacy. Counter from the time annotation files had their own ids. Not used.

additionalProperties.description: Legacy. Local-folder mode wrote the saving user's entry here, at the top level, keyed by user id, next to (or instead of) annotationfiles. Readers that only know annotationfiles miss it.
